reviews.comment: Online class. No interaction with the professor unless you go to his office hours. He narrates the slides. I think the TAs do all the grading. Once in a while they give a random bad grade for no reason and when you ask about it you don't get a response. The material was interesting though. I would take this class again.

Professor Paudyal's class is a great science credit to take. No exams, quizzes every week along with weekly packback discussions, and 1 project. I found the class to be easy and manageable, and you get 2 attempts per quiz (they are also open note)

This class is an easy A. There are weekly quizzes that are directly from the slides and the assignments that are given are very easy. There is a group project that was difficult considering its was an asynchronous class, but he graded easy. Overall, a great choice for a science credit.

Asynchronous course. One of the easiest classes I've ever done. As someone on the prevet track too, I thought the material was super interesting. Weekly tasks are packback, quizzes, lecture videos, assignments (that are super easy), and a group project. Only thing is don't get the required material! It's literally just ppt slides that you get later

Dr. Paudyal is a great professor! He is very knowledgeable about animal science, and puts subtitles on his lectures, which makes it easy to understand him. If you do the work and watch the lectures, you will make a good grade in his class.
